about: Official figures behind the essay japan-basic-income-cost (cost of a basic income in Japan at five monthly amounts, what it could replace, and a consumption-tax yardstick). build.js recomputes the essay's two tables from this file and the calculator data (CALC for the population, CALC_WORLD for the $3-a-day line) and warns on drift; brand/x/infographics/render.js draws the X images from it. Amounts in yen.

population.note: final estimate (確定値), Population Estimates October 2026 report, released 20 October 2026; same figure as CALC jp pop.all

adults.note: aged 20 and over, same report; same figure as CALC jp pop.adults

taxRevenue.note: general-account tax and stamp revenue, settled (決算), ¥842,226 hundred million; national taxes only

budget.note: general-account initial budget (令和8年度当初予算), ¥122,309,247,035 thousand; same figure as CALC jp budget.total

gdp.note: nominal GDP, fiscal year April 2025 to March 2026, Cabinet Office QE 2026 Jul-Sep first preliminary estimate (¥672,682.0 billion)

socialBenefits.note: social security benefit expenditure (社会保障給付費, ILO basis), IPSS; pensions ¥57.8528 trillion, medical care ¥44.8055 trillion, welfare and other ¥35.6436 trillion

consumptionTax.note: national consumption tax, settled, ¥260,277 hundred million (same MOF table as taxRevenue)

consumptionTaxRates.note: the national share is 78% of the combined rate at both rates (local consumption tax 22/78 of the national tax), so national revenue / 0.78 is the combined national and local revenue

levels.note: the World Bank's $3.00-a-day poverty line in Japanese prices, from the calculator data (CALC_WORLD jp line.monthly)
first preset on /calc/jp/; the child allowance for a first or second child aged 3 to 18
last preset on /calc/jp/; the 2020 Special Cash Payment was ¥100,000 once

harada.note: Yutaka Harada's design (20 and over ¥70,000, under 20 ¥30,000), as in the Takenaka essay and HOUSEHOLD.kidAlt

offsets.note: child allowance cash benefits (児童手当, family benefits column), IPSS Summary Table 2: ¥2,113,800 million; only 4 of the 12 months at the October 2024 expanded rates

public assistance living assistance (生活扶助) ¥1,033.4 billion + housing assistance (住宅扶助) ¥603.1 billion, actual, project-cost basis; medical ¥1,834.1 billion and long-term care ¥102.1 billion kept; total ¥3,600.7 billion

total annual amount of National Pension (basic pension) benefits for recipients at the end of FY2024, ¥25,889.7 billion, 36.30 million recipients (old-age, disability, survivors); average old-age ¥59,000 a month
total annual amount of all public pension benefits for recipients at the end of FY2024 (National Pension and Employees' Pension, incl. mutual aid), ¥58,331.1 billion
